name: @gesslar/lpc-language-tmgrammar-hl
description: TextMate grammar for LPC (Lars Pensjö C) syntax highlighting

scripts.sync-grammar: tag=$(gh api repos/jlchmura/lpc-language-server/releases/latest --jq .tag_name) && echo "Syncing grammars from $tag" && for f in lpc.tmLanguage.json lpcdoc.injection.tmLanguage.json; do curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jlchmura/lpc-language-server/$tag/syntaxes/$f" -o "$f" || exit 1; done
